name: gaia-consult
description: Reference guide for the full manual Gaia curation pipeline. Invoke at any phase when unsure what command to type next: gaia-curate, L4 review, gaia push, ev-pipeline (Phases 0–4), gaia-ingest, or close. Trigger phrases: "/gaia-consult", "what's the command for", "remind me how to", "I'm lost in the pipeline", "what do I do next", "consult the pipeline doc", "pipeline reference".
